name: Hierarchical Finite Element Compression Scheme
definition: A uniform 4D compression scheme that replaces quantization and encoding steps with a dedicated sparse data structure, enabling efficient random access for hyperslice reconstruction of large multidimensional scalar fields.
summary: The Hierarchical Finite Element Compression Scheme is a uniform 4D compression method that replaces traditional quantization with a sparse data structure, using non-overlapping basis functions to reduce reconstruction cost.
